Telecommunications, Annual: Total Mobile Phone Subscriptions, At End Of Period
column4: With effect from Nov 2024, 'Total Mobile Subscriptions' includes 4G and 5G subscriptions (including both pre-paid and post-paid).  Data for 4G and 5G subscriptions are collected from Mar 2013 and Jul 2022 respectively.  With effect from Apr 2017, total Post-paid and Pre-paid Subscriptions (2G) had ceased service.  With effect from Nov 2024, total Post-paid and Pre-paid subscriptions (3G) had been discontinued.

Telecommunications, Annual: Total Post-Paid Subscriptions (2G), At End Of Period
column4: This series has been discontinued.  With effect from Apr 2017, total Post-paid and Pre-paid Subscriptions (2G) has ceased service.

Telecommunications, Annual: Total Pre-Paid Subscriptions (2G), At End Of Period
column4: This series has been discontinued.  With effect from Apr 2017, total Post-paid and Pre-paid Subscriptions (2G) has ceased service.

Telecommunications, Annual: Total Subscriptions (3G), At End Of Period
column4: Prior to Nov 2007, data cover post-paid subscriptions.  With effect from Nov 2007, data include pre-paid and post-paid 3G subscriptions.  Figures prior to Dec 2009 comprise both pre-paid and post-paid 3G subscriptions combined.  Data breakdown for pre-paid and post-paid 3G subscriptions are available with effect from Dec 2009.  With effect from Nov 2024, total Post-paid and Pre-paid subscriptions (3G) had been discontinued.

Telecommunications, Annual: Total Post-Paid Subscriptions (3G), At End Of Period
column4: With effect from Nov 2024, total Post-paid and Pre-paid subscriptions (3G) had been discontinued.

Telecommunications, Annual: Total Pre-Paid Subscriptions (3G), At End Of Period
column4: Number of Pre-paid 3G subscriptions fell from Jan 2023 with subscribers migrating to more advanced 4G/5G technologies.  With effect from Nov 2024, total Post-paid and Pre-paid subscriptions (3G) had been discontinued.

Telecommunications, Annual: International Telephone Call Minutes
column4: Prior to 1996, figures refer to financial year.  From 1998 to 2000, figures include real-time fax and budget call services.  Prior to 2001, figures exclude calls to Malaysia.  From 2001, figures include traffic contributed by new service providers such as ISR operators.  From Jul 2004, figures include traffic contributed by all Service-Based Operators (SBO).  This figure includes total retail outgoing international call minutes as well as transit minutes and includes all Service-Based Operators (SBO).

Telecommunications, Annual: Total Broadband Internet Subscriptions, At End Of Period
column4: With effect from Apr 2007, Total Broadband Subscriptions (i.e. for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) includes retail xDSL, cable modems, leased line Internet, 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wi-Fi hotspots access (including Wireless@SG subscriptions).  Provision of Broadband Internet access services via cable modem has ceased since 2020.  Data for Oct 2022 was incomplete due to incomplete data returns from operators.  Data for Oct 2023 exclude one Wireless@SG Operators' figures due to server maintenance.

Telecommunications, Annual: Total Wireless Broadband Subscriptions, At End Of Period
column4: Total Wireless Broadband Subscriptions includes all retail broadband Internet access subscriptions (i.e., for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) provided via wireless platforms such as 3G, 3.5G/HSDPA, 4G/LTE, WiMAX or its equivalent and Wi-Fi hotspots (including Wireless@SG subscriptions).  From 2018, the Wireless@SG subscriptions will only include active users for the month.  Data for Oct 2022 was incomplete due to incomplete data returns from operators.  Data for Oct 2023 exclude one Wireless@SG Operators' figures due to server maintenance.

Telecommunications, Annual: Residential Wired Broadband Subscriptions, At End Of Period
column4: Total Residential Wired Broadband includes all retail residential wired broadband subscriptions (i.e. for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) provided over xDSL, cable modems, leased line and optical fibre.  Residential wireless broadband subscriptions will be excluded.  Provision of Broadband Internet access services via cable modem has ceased since 2020.

Telecommunications, Annual: Corporate Wired Broadband Subscriptions, At End Of Period
column4: Total Corporate Wired Broadband includes all retail corporate wired broadband subscriptions (i.e. for connection speeds equal to, or greater than, 256 kbit/s, in one or both directions) provided over xDSL, cable modems, leased line and optical fibre.  Corporate wireless broadband subscriptions will be excluded.  Provision of Broadband Internet access services via cable modem has ceased since 2020.

Telecommunications, Annual: Total Number Of SMS Messages
column4: Data include SMS messages sent and received over the following mobile networks: - 2G (from Jul 2004 to Apr 2007), 3G (from May 2005) and 4G (from Mar 2013).

Telecommunications, Annual: Mobile Data Usage
column4: Mobile data usage reflects the amount of bi-directional (the aggregated total downloaded) mobile data sent over the mobile networks, including MMS and any other data upload/download but excludes video telephony and SMS.  1 Petabyte is equivalent to 1,048,576 Gigabyte.

Telecommunications, Annual: Population Coverage By At Least A 2G Mobile Network
column4: Data refer to the proportion covered by at least a 2G mobile network, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers or users.  Data are used for SDG 9.c.1 'Proportion of population covered by a mobile network, by technology'.

Telecommunications, Annual: Population Coverage By At Least A 3G Mobile Network
column4: Data refer to the proportion covered by at least a 3G mobile network, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers or users.  Data are used for SDG 9.c.1 'Proportion of population covered by a mobile network, by technology'.

Telecommunications, Annual: Population Coverage By At Least A 4G Mobile Network
column4: Data refer to the proportion covered by at least a 4G mobile network, irrespective of whether or not they are subscribers or users.  Data are used for SDG 9.c.1 'Proportion of population covered by a mobile network, by technology'.
